# ensemble:trd-execute

> **Mission:** Canonical bead-hierarchy execution engine. Takes a free-text GOAL and drives all unblocked beads matching that goal to completion through the implement/belief-worker pipeline with bv/br graph-aware dispatch, phase quality gates, and TRD traceability augmentation when --trd is provided. This is NOT invoked directly by users in normal workflow. It is the execution engine called by: /ensemble:implement-trd-beads <trd> --execute  (passes goal="implement all tasks for <trd>", scope=[trd:<TRD_SLUG>:task:]) /ensemble:beads-build <epic-or-slug>            (passes goal="implement <epic>", scope=[<EPIC_SLUG>]) Key behaviors: - bv --robot-next is the PRIMARY dispatcher for both single-agent and team modes - The bv result is scoped/validated: if it falls outside the current scope, it is rejected and scoped br ready is used instead - br ready (scoped) is the fallback when bv is unavailable or returns empty - TRD mode (--trd): enables traceability tokens, TRD checkbox sync, req satisfaction - TEAM_MODE: enables lead orchestration loop with reviewer/QA delegation and metrics - Quality Gate: runs after each phase completes; scope adjusts for team QA coverage - Completion: closes epic, syncs TRD checkboxes, prints requirement satisfaction report /ensemble:beads-build <epic>                 (after epic discovery/preflight) Key behaviors: - bv --robot-next is the PRIMARY dispatcher for both single-agent and team modes - br ready filtered by epic slug is the fallback when bv is unavailable - TRD mode (--trd): enables traceability tokens, TRD checkbox sync, req satisfaction - TEAM_MODE: enables lead orchestration loop with reviewer/QA delegation and metrics - Quality Gate: runs after each phase completes; scope adjusts for team QA coverage - Completion: closes epic, syncs TRD checkboxes, prints requirement satisfaction report

## Phase 1: Preflight

### Step 1: Argument Parsing

Parse GOAL (required free-text), --epic (optional), --trd path, --strategy, --team-config, --max-parallel

**Actions:**
1. Parse $ARGUMENTS: first token(s) = GOAL (required free-text; all remaining text before any --flag is the goal description)
2. Parse --epic <id-or-slug> from $ARGUMENTS; if present set EPIC_FILTER=<value>; else EPIC_FILTER is unset (bv will score across all open beads)
3. Parse --trd <path> from $ARGUMENTS; if present set TRD_MODE=true and TRD_PATH=<path>; else TRD_MODE=false
4. Parse --strategy <value>; valid: tdd, characterization, bug-fix, refactor, test-after, flexible; default: tdd
5. Parse --team-config <yaml-snippet>; if present parse and set TEAM_MODE=true; else TEAM_MODE=false
6. Parse --max-parallel N; default MAX_PARALLEL=1

### Step 2: Tool Availability Check

Verify br is installed and functional, detect bv availability

**Actions:**
1. which br || { echo 'ERROR: br (beads_rust) not installed. Install from https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/beads_rust'; exit 1; }
2. br list --status=open > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: br not functional'; exit 1; }
3. which bv && BV_AVAILABLE=true || { echo 'WARNING: bv (beads_viewer) not installed. Graph-aware triage will be unavailable. Install from https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/beads_viewer'; BV_AVAILABLE=false; }
4. Resolve TRD_CLI (used only when TRD_MODE=true): set TRD_CLI to the first path that exists among: "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/trd-cli.js", "packages/development/lib/trd-cli.js". If neither exists OR 'which node' fails: print 'ERROR: Node.js and TRD CLI (lib/trd-cli.js) are required for TRD parsing.' and exit 1.

### Step 3: TRD Augmentation Setup (TRD_MODE only)

Validate TRD file and build traceability map when --trd is provided. Must run before Goal Resolution since Goal Resolution references TRD_SLUG and TRD_TO_BEAD_MAP.

**Actions:**
1. If TRD_MODE=false: set TASK_TRACEABILITY={}; set TRD_TO_BEAD_MAP={}; set PHASE_TASK_IDS={}; TRD_SLUG is unset; print 'TRD augmentations: disabled'; skip remaining steps in this phase
2. If TRD_MODE=true: verify TRD_PATH file exists; if not print 'ERROR: TRD file not found at <TRD_PATH>' and HALT
3. Read TRD file; parse YAML frontmatter for design_readiness_score; if score exists and score < 3.0 print 'ERROR: TRD has Design Readiness score of <score> (FAIL). Run /ensemble:refine-trd to improve before implementation.' and HALT; if 3.0 <= score < 4.0 print 'WARNING: Design Readiness score of <score> (CONCERNS).'
4. Run: node "$TRD_CLI" parse "<TRD_PATH>" -> parse {ok, tasksById, storiesByPhase}
5. If ok is false or non-zero exit: print error and HALT
6. Build TASK_TRACEABILITY map: for each taskId, task in tasksById — extract satisfies_req_id, verifies_task_id, is_test_task, is_ac_synthetic, is_xc_synthetic, dependsOn; store in TASK_TRACEABILITY[taskId]
7. Derive TRD_SLUG from TRD_PATH filename (lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric with hyphens)
8. Build TRD_TO_BEAD_MAP: run br list --all --title-contains '[trd:<TRD_SLUG>:task:' --json; for each bead with title '[trd:<TRD_SLUG>:task:<TASK_ID>]' record TRD_TO_BEAD_MAP[TASK_ID]=bead.id; for each bead record BEAD_TO_TASK_MAP[bead.id]=TASK_ID
9. Build PHASE_TASK_IDS: from storiesByPhase — for each phaseN, story in storiesByPhase record PHASE_TASK_IDS[phaseN] = [task.id for each task in story.tasks]
10. Print 'TRD augmentations: enabled (<N> tasks, <M> phases)'

### Step 4: Goal Resolution

Build GOAL_SCOPE_SET (ALL beads, all statuses, immutable). Explicit scope (--trd or --epic) bypasses br search entirely. Only unscoped direct goals use br search + descendant expansion. HALT only on genuinely conflicting epic scopes.

**Actions:**
1. Determine scope source — exactly one applies:
2. 
3. CASE A — TRD_MODE==true (--trd provided):
4. GOAL_SCOPE_SET = all bead ids in TRD_TO_BEAD_MAP.values (the TRD's task beads)
5. ROOT_EPIC_ID, EPIC_SLUG derived from the epic that owns these beads
6. Print: 'Scope: TRD <TRD_SLUG> (<N> beads, all statuses)'
7. No conflict detection needed — scope is unambiguous
8. 
9. CASE B — TRD_MODE==false AND --epic <id-or-slug> provided:

11. GOAL_SCOPE_SET = all descendant task bead ids of ROOT_EPIC_ID
12. EPIC_SLUG derived from the epic bead
13. Print: 'Scope: epic <epic-title> (<N> beads, all statuses)'
14. No conflict detection needed — scope is unambiguous
15. 
16. CASE C — Neither --trd nor --epic provided (unscoped direct goal):
17. Run: br search "$GOAL" --json  (full-text search across bead titles and descriptions)
18. Let SEARCH_MATCHES = beads returned by search
19. For each epic in SEARCH_MATCHES: include all descendant task beads of that epic (expand to full scope)
20. GOAL_SCOPE_SET = union of all descendant task beads of every matched epic
21. SCOPE_PREFIXES = one prefix per unique epic in GOAL_SCOPE_SET
22. CONFLICT DETECTION: group GOAL_SCOPE_SET by ROOT_EPIC_ID. If beads from MORE THAN ONE epic are present, check whether the epics have mutually incompatible goals (e.g., one epic is for project A, another for project B).
23. If mutually incompatible: print 'ERROR: GOAL resolves to beads from conflicting epics:' followed by each epic title and ID. HALT.
24. If same-feature different-phase: this is NOT a conflict — proceed.
25. Print: 'Scope: goal "$GOAL" (<N> beads from <M> epic(s), all statuses)'

29. If epic mismatch: print 'ERROR: --epic <epic-id> does not match the epic owning TRD task beads. Use --trd alone or correct --epic.' and HALT
30. GOAL_SCOPE_SET = all descendant task bead ids of ROOT_EPIC_ID (epic scope, NOT TRD_TO_BEAD_MAP)
31. EPIC_SLUG derived from the epic bead
32. TRD_MODE remains true — TRD Augmentation Setup already ran; TASK_TRACEABILITY and BEAD_TO_TASK_MAP are available for traceability
33. Print: 'Scope: epic <epic-title> (<N> beads, all statuses) — TRD augmentations enabled'
34. 
35. After GOAL_SCOPE_SET is built:
36. If GOAL_SCOPE_SET is empty: print 'ERROR: GOAL "$GOAL" resolved to zero matching beads. No tasks found.' and HALT.
37. Print 'GOAL: "$GOAL"' — 'Goal scope set: <N> beads (all statuses)'
38. Resume check: br list --status=in_progress --json; filter to beads whose id is in GOAL_SCOPE_SET; count IN_PROGRESS_COUNT. If > 0: print 'Resume: <IN_PROGRESS_COUNT> task(s) already in-progress within goal scope.'

Detect team configuration from --team-config argument or TRD Team Configuration section

Determine implementation strategy

**Actions:**

## Phase 2: Execute

### Step 1: Execution Engine

bv/br graph-aware task dispatch loop — single-agent DRAIN LOOP or Lead Orchestration Loop. AC: FR-GD-1, FR-GD-2, FR-GD-3, AC-TD-3, AC-BC-1

**Actions:**
1. NOTE: bv --robot-next is the PRIMARY dispatcher for both TEAM_MODE=false and TEAM_MODE=true. br ready is the fallback when BV_AVAILABLE=false.
2. IMPORTANT — Loop Design: This loop runs entirely inside the current AI turn via blocking Task() calls. The supervisor re-invokes this command to resume after each drain. A YAML 'LOOP:' block is prose that renders as a Markdown bullet — it is NOT a real loop interpreter.
3. Termination guarantee (in-session drain): After closing each task, re-poll scoped br ready. If candidates remain, continue. When br ready returns empty AND no in-flight tasks (in_progress with sub-state in_review or in_qa) remain, the drain is complete for this session.
4. Non-Interactive Progress Policy: Do NOT stop for routine progress summaries. After every 10 task completions, print one terse line: 'Progress: <N> tasks completed; continuing automatically.' Continue automatically until Completion or a real user decision is required.
5. A real user decision means: invalid/cyclic graph needing edge choice, failed quality gate needing fix/skip/abort, exhausted debug/review/rejection retries, dirty working tree, failed br/git command, or missing required tool/config.
6. If output from a task exceeds 500 lines, summarize it into a br comment and continue; do not stop for context-budget advice.
7. 
8. TEAM_MODE Gate:
9. if TEAM_MODE == false:
10. - Run the single-agent DRAIN LOOP below
11. - After DRAIN LOOP step (c) RETURN: advance to Quality Gate phase
12. - Steps 2 through 10 are TEAM_MODE=true helpers; never reached in single-agent mode
13. if TEAM_MODE == true:
14. - Run the Lead Orchestration Loop below (parallel builders, reviewer/QA delegation)
15. - RETURN after Lead Orchestration Loop exits

18. SINGLE-AGENT DRAIN LOOP (TEAM_MODE=false)

22.

25. - Filter to beads whose id is IN GOAL_SCOPE_SET -> READY_SET
26. - Run: br list --status=in_progress --json; filter to beads whose id is IN GOAL_SCOPE_SET -> INFLIGHT_LIST
27. - For each bead in INFLIGHT_LIST: call get_sub_state(bead_id)
28. - If sub_state in ('in_review', 'in_qa'): add to INFLIGHT_ACTIVE list

32. - REMAINING = GOAL_SCOPE_SET.size - CLOSED_COUNT
33. - If REMAINING == 0:
34. All beads in the goal scope are closed.
35. Print: 'Goal scope drained: <N>/<N> beads closed. Execute phase complete.'
36. RETURN from Execute phase — advance to Quality Gate
37. Do NOT fall through to dispatch steps below.
38. - If REMAINING > 0:
39. - If READY_SET is empty AND INFLIGHT_ACTIVE is empty:
40. Beads remain open or in-progress but none are currently dispatchable (blocked by dependencies or phase ordering).
41. Print: 'Stalled: <REMAINING> bead(s) remain but none are ready. Blockers may still be open. Halting — re-run to resume.'
42. HALT this invocation — supervisor will re-invoke when blockers complete
43. - If READY_SET is empty AND INFLIGHT_ACTIVE is non-empty:
44. Normal in-flight state (dispatched tasks with reviewer/QA in progress).
45. Print: 'Progress: <CLOSED_COUNT>/<GOAL_SCOPE_SET.size> beads done; <N> in-flight (review/QA). Halting — re-run to resume.'
46. HALT this invocation — supervisor will re-invoke to resume
47. - If READY_SET is non-empty: proceed to step (d)
48. 
49. d. SELECTION AND RANKING (bv primary, PHASE_ELIGIBLE_SET first, deterministic fallback):
50. Initialize: SELECTED = unset (empty) at the start of each dispatch round
51. Order: (1) compute phase-eligible set from trd-cli; (2) bv validates against it; (3) deterministic fallback only if SELECTED remains unset. Never re-call bv in the same dispatch round.
52. 
53. (1) TRD_MODE phase eligibility (computed FIRST, before bv):
54. If TRD_MODE == true:
55. Compute READY_TRD_IDS: for each bead id in READY_SET, look up BEAD_TO_TASK_MAP[bead_id] -> TRD-NNN id; join with commas
56. Compute CLOSED_TRD_IDS: run br list --status=closed --json; intersect with GOAL_SCOPE_SET (immutable); for each look up BEAD_TO_TASK_MAP -> TRD-NNN; join with commas
57. Run: node "$TRD_CLI" next-task "<TRD_FILE_PATH>" --ready "<READY_TRD_IDS>" --closed "<CLOSED_TRD_IDS>" --max <count of READY_TRD_IDS>  (pass the full count so trd-cli returns ALL candidates in the lowest incomplete phase, not just one — bv is the primary selector among them)
58. If trd-cli returns ok=false or non-zero exit: print error and HALT

61. If PHASE_ELIGIBLE_SET is empty: this phase is blocked; print 'Phase blocked: no phase-eligible beads. Halting — re-run to resume when prerequisites complete.' and HALT

63. PHASE_ELIGIBLE_SET = READY_SET  (all ready beads are eligible)

75. If BV_AVAILABLE == false: fall through to deterministic fallback
76. 
77. (3) Deterministic fallback (only if SELECTED is still unset):

102. - If test_passed == 'true': require commit_sha != 'none' and commit_sha == $(git rev-parse HEAD) — if SHA is missing or differs: print 'AUDIT ERROR: test-passed=true but commit-sha is missing or does not match HEAD for <BEAD_ID>.' and HALT

106. - Require COMMENT_VERDICT == 'proven'; if not: reset bead to open, write verdict comment, amend git commit, HALT
107. - If COMMENT_VERDICT == 'proven': write 'ac-proven:<AC_ID>' comment; resolve REQ_ID and write root epic req-verified token
108. - For XC-* beads (TRD_MODE=true AND TASK_TRACEABILITY[TASK_ID].is_xc_synthetic == true):

110. - If proven: write 'xc-proven:<XC_ID>' comment and root epic attestation
111. - For regular task beads (TRD_MODE=false or non-synthetic):
112. - Verify test_passed == true; record completion
113. - Sync: br sync --flush-only; amend bead/epic comments into worker commit: git add .beads/beads.jsonl && git commit --amend --no-edit

117. - If TRD_MODE == true:

135. - HALT this invocation — supervisor will re-invoke to resume

140. LEAD ORCHESTRATION LOOP (TEAM_MODE=true)
141. ===================================================================
142. 
143. Variables: active_builders = {} (bead_id -> builder_agent)
144. 
145. LOOP:
146. 1. br sync --flush-only (ensure JSONL current)
147. 
148. 2. Check in-flight tasks:

151. - If sub_state == 'in_review': proceed to Reviewer Delegation step (step 3a)
152. - If sub_state == 'in_qa': proceed to QA Delegation step (step 3b)
153. - If sub_state == 'in_progress': task is with builder (normal)
154. 
155. 3. Count available slots: available_slots = MAX_PARALLEL - len(active_builders)
156. 
157. 4. If available_slots > 0:
158. - Get next tasks: if BV_AVAILABLE, run bv --robot-next --format toon; else run br ready filtered by scope prefix
159. - For each task (up to available_slots):
160. a. Architecture Review: check task description for 'architecture', 'design', 'system', 'cross-cutting', 'multi-component', 'orchestrat' — if found generate guidance notes and record in br comment
161. b. Lead Skip Decision: if documentation-only -> SKIP_REVIEW=true, SKIP_QA=true; if REVIEWER_ENABLED=false -> SKIP_REVIEW=true; if QA_ENABLED=false -> SKIP_QA=true; record decisions in br comment; transition directly if both skipped
162. c. Sibling Task Context: collect completed sibling tasks in same phase (up to 5 most recent closed); add to builder prompt
163. d. Select builder from TEAM_ROLES.builder.agents using keyword matching
164. e. validate_transition(bead_id, 'in_progress') -- write status comment
165. f. Delegate to builder via Task(subagent_type=<builder>, prompt=<builder_prompt>)
166. g. active_builders[bead_id] = builder
167. 
168. 5. Check loop exit:
169. - If no tasks returned by bv/br AND no active_builders AND no in-flight tasks: break to Completion
170. - If no tasks returned but tasks exist in_review or in_qa: wait (check in-flight next iteration)
171. 
172. 6. br sync --flush-only
173. 7. Continue LOOP
174. 
175. --- Parallel Builder Execution ---
176. When available_slots > 1 AND multiple tasks are ready:
177. TRD-025-1. Set BUILDER_SLOTS = MAX_PARALLEL
178. TRD-025-2. Get candidates: if BV_AVAILABLE -> bv --robot-plan --format toon; else -> br ready filtered by scope prefix; take up to BUILDER_SLOTS
179. TRD-025-3. File conflict detection: for each candidate, extract target file paths from bead description; prevent assigning tasks with overlapping file targets
180. TRD-025-4. Launch concurrent Task() delegations for conflict-free tasks (Phase A: sequential pre-flight per task; Phase B: concurrent dispatch; Phase C: sequential post-dispatch bookkeeping)
181. TRD-025-5. Wait for all parallel builders to complete
182. TRD-025-6. Process each builder result sequentially: after each pipeline finishes (review + QA), remove from active_builders; check phase gate; break dispatch if phase completes
183. 
184. --- Sequential Commit Ordering (TRD-026) ---
185. COMMIT_QUEUE = ordered list of tasks whose pipelines completed successfully
186. For each task in COMMIT_QUEUE (one at a time):
187. - Run: git diff --name-only HEAD; if no file conflicts: commit with task reference; if conflict: one retry; if still failing: br update <bead_id> --status=open and continue
188. After all commits: br sync --flush-only
189. 
190. --- Parallel Builder Failure Isolation (TRD-027) ---
191. If one builder fails: reset bead to open, record verdict:failed audit comment (NO status: prefix), other builders continue unaffected, slot is freed immediately, refill available slots on next iteration
192. 
193. LEAD ORCHESTRATION LOOP RETURN:
194. - If PENDING_GATE == true: RETURN (Quality Gate consumes it)
195. - If PENDING_GATE == false: normal loop continuation

### Step 2: Task Claim and Specialist Selection

Claim task in beads before delegating to specialist agent (TEAM_MODE=true helper; single-agent uses implement-bead-worker)

**Actions:**
1. Run: br update <BEAD_ID> --status=in_progress — skip task if exit code != 0 (already claimed)
2. Extract TASK_ID from task.title prefix (TRD-NNN pattern if TRD_MODE; use bead title text otherwise)
3. Select specialist by keyword matching: architecture/design/system/multi-component/cross-cutting/orchestrat -> @tech-lead-orchestrator; backend/api/endpoint/database/server/model/migration -> @backend-developer; frontend/ui/component/react/vue/angular/svelte/css -> @frontend-developer; test/spec/e2e/playwright/coverage -> @test-runner or @playwright-tester; docs/readme/documentation/changelog/api-docs -> @documentation-specialist; infra/deploy/docker/k8s/kubernetes/aws/cloud/terraform -> @infrastructure-developer; default -> @backend-developer
4. Resolve via AGENT_ALIAS_MAP before delegation (e.g. backend-developer -> ensemble-full:backend-developer)
5. Check .claude/router-rules.json first; project-specific agents take priority over keyword defaults

### Step 3: Task Delegation

Build prompt and delegate to selected specialist (TEAM_MODE=true only; single-agent uses implement-bead-worker)

**Actions:**
1. Build prompt with: Task ID + bead ID, TRD file path (if TRD_MODE), strategy, completed tasks this phase, acceptance criteria, inferred file paths, matched skills, strategy-specific instructions
2. Builder prompt construction MUST follow these context curation rules:
3. - Include ONLY: task description from bead, TRD section for this task (if TRD_MODE), architecture guidance (if any), sibling context (if any)
4. - Do NOT include: full TRD content, other phase tasks, conversation history, previous builder outputs
5. - Include the file path(s) the task targets so the builder can Read them directly
6. - Each builder subagent starts with clean context — this is intentional for quality
7. Include: 'When done, provide a structured summary: files changed, what was implemented, any issues encountered, and recommendations for follow-up work.'
8. IMPORTANT (TEAM_MODE=true): Do NOT close this bead. Return structured summary with files_changed, implementation_description, test_results, issues_encountered, recommendations.
9. Delegate: Task(agent_type=<resolved_specialist>, prompt=<prompt>)
10. On success: br comment add <BEAD_ID> 'Implementation complete: <agent_summary>'; proceed to next step
11. On failure: br comment add <BEAD_ID> 'Failed: <error_summary>. Files touched: <changed_files>. Agent: <specialist_type>.'; br update <BEAD_ID> --status=open; enter debug loop

### Step 4: Reviewer Delegation and Verdict Handling (TEAM_MODE=true only)

Delegate to reviewer after builder submits, parse verdict, route accordingly. AC: FR-CR-1 through FR-CR-6, FR-LL-3

**Actions:**
1. Build reviewer prompt: bead ID and task title; files changed; builder implementation_description; TRD acceptance criteria; strategy and coverage targets; test results
2. Instruction: 'Review the implementation. Return verdict: APPROVED or REJECTED. If REJECTED: provide specific feedback with file, line, issue, and suggestion.'
3. Delegate: Task(subagent_type=<TEAM_ROLES.reviewer.agents[0]>, prompt=<reviewer_prompt>)
4. Parse reviewer response for APPROVED or REJECTED keyword; extract rejection reason if REJECTED
5. On APPROVED: validate_transition(bead_id, 'in_qa'); proceed to QA Delegation (step 3b)
6. On REJECTED: validate_transition(bead_id, 'in_progress'); increment rejection count; re-delegate to builder with rejection context

### Step 5: QA Delegation and Verdict Handling (TEAM_MODE=true only)

Delegate to QA agent after reviewer approves, parse verdict, route accordingly. AC: FR-QA-1 through FR-QA-6, FR-LL-4

**Actions:**
1. Build QA prompt: bead ID and task title; files changed; builder implementation_description; reviewer verdict and notes; TRD acceptance criteria; strategy and coverage targets; test results
2. Delegate to @test-runner first for fresh test execution: Task(subagent_type=test-runner, prompt='Run tests for changed files: <files_changed>. Report pass/fail and coverage.')
3. Build augmented QA prompt with test_results; delegate to TEAM_ROLES.qa.agents[0]
4. QA validates: all acceptance criteria met; test coverage meets strategy targets; no regressions; code quality and security
5. QA returns verdict: PASSED or REJECTED with specific issues
6. On PASSED: validate_transition(bead_id, 'closed'); br sync --flush-only; update TRD checkbox if TRD_MODE; git commit; record metrics
7. On REJECTED: validate_transition(bead_id, 'in_progress'); br update <bead_id> --status=open; increment rejection count; return to builder with QA feedback

### Step 6: Rejection Loop with Builder Re-Delegation (TEAM_MODE=true only)

Triggered by reviewer or QA REJECTED. Collects full rejection context, enforces MAX_REJECTIONS cap, re-delegates or escalates to lead. AC: FR-LL-5, AC-SM-3, AC-SM-4

**Actions:**
1. Collect full rejection context: br comment list <bead_id>; extract ALL verdict:rejected comments; build rejection_context
2. Check rejection_count against MAX_REJECTIONS (default 2):
3. If rejection_count < MAX_REJECTIONS: identify original builder from first status:in_progress assigned: comment; re-delegate to same builder with rejection context; continue through full pipeline
4. If rejection_count >= MAX_REJECTIONS: lead architectural review; lead decision options: restructure task, adjust acceptance criteria, reassign to different builder, architectural fix; record lead decision in br comment; allow one more cycle; if still failing: PAUSE for user decision

### Step 7: Team Metrics Collection (TEAM_MODE=true only)

In-memory metrics accumulator invoked after each task closure. Tracks per-builder stats, rejection cycles, and time-in-state. AC: FR-TM-1, FR-TM-2, FR-TM-3

**Actions:**
1. Initialization (once at Execute phase start when TEAM_MODE=true): TEAM_METRICS = {phase: <current_phase_number>, tasks_completed: 0, builders: {}, task_details: []}
2. After each task closure:
3. 1. Identify builder agent: br comment list <bead_id>; scan for first 'status:in_progress assigned:<agent>' comment
4. 2. Count rejection cycles: count lines containing exact token 'verdict:rejected' after lead-reset baseline
5. 3. Extract timestamps from br comments; compute time_in_progress, time_in_review, time_in_qa
6. 4. Update TEAM_METRICS: increment tasks_completed; update per-builder stats; append task_details entry
7. At Quality Gate completion: include TEAM_METRICS summary in gate result comment

### Step 8: Definition of Done and Code Review

Mandatory Definition of Done validation plus code review before task closure (TEAM_MODE=false path; TEAM_MODE=true uses reviewer/QA delegation)

**Actions:**
1. Definition of Done gate: before ANY br close for a task bead, verify: code artifact exists; unit tests exist and pass; integration/API test exists; build succeeds; no new FIXME/DISABLED/STUB files; cross-cutting requirements verified when applicable; acceptance criteria explicitly proven
2. For AC-* synthetic beads: write br comment 'ac-validation:<AC_ID> verdict:<proven|not_proven>'; only close when verdict:proven
3. For XC-* synthetic beads: write br comment 'xc-validation:<XC_ID> verdict:<proven|not_proven>'; only close when verdict:proven
4. Delegate to @code-reviewer: 'Review the changes for task <TASK_ID>. Files: <changed_files>. Check for correctness, security, coverage, quality.'
5. If approved: br close <BEAD_ID>; br sync --flush-only; update TRD checkbox if TRD_MODE; git commit
6. If rejected with fixable issues: delegate back to specialist with review feedback (max 2 rounds)
7. If rejected after 2 rounds: PAUSE for user decision
8. Skip code review only if strategy == 'flexible' or task is docs-only

### Step 9: Debug Loop

Attempt automated fix on task failure via deep-debugger (max 2 retries)

**Actions:**
1. Delegate to @deep-debugger with error details, changed files, strategy, bead ID
2. If fix applied: re-run tests; if pass -> proceed to next step; if fail -> retry
3. After 2 retries: br comment add <BEAD_ID> 'Debug loop exhausted after 2 retries. Root cause: <analysis>. Manual intervention required.'; PAUSE for user decision

### Step 10: Error Handling

Handle br command failures during execution

**Actions:**
1. After any br command: if exit code != 0 AND prior br commands in session succeeded -> possible br failure
2. Print error message with br command that failed and its exit code; print: check br status and .beads/ directory integrity
3. PAUSE for user decision

### Step 11: Utility: Sub-State Query Function (get_sub_state)

Inline utility. Reads br comment history in reverse to find the most recent status: comment. AC: FR-SM-2, FR-BR-2

**Actions:**
1. Function: get_sub_state(bead_id) -> (state, metadata_dict)
2. Run: br comment list <bead_id>; scan lines in REVERSE ORDER for line starting with 'status:'
3. Extract state (first token after 'status:') and remaining key:value metadata pairs
4. URL-decode 'reason:' values; return (state, {key: value, ...})
5. If no 'status:' comment found: fall back to br native status; map: 'open'->('open',{}), 'in_progress'->('in_progress',{}), 'closed'->('closed',{})

### Step 12: Utility: Rejection Cycle Tracking and Cap

Inline utility. Invoked after any verdict:rejected comment; enforces MAX_REJECTIONS cap. AC: FR-SM-7, AC-SM-4

**Actions:**
1. Count rejection cycles for this bead (respecting lead-reset baseline): scan br comment list; find most recent 'lead-reset:true' line as BASELINE_LINE_INDEX; count 'verdict:rejected' tokens after that line
2. If REJECTION_COUNT < MAX_REJECTIONS: return task to builder with full rejection context
3. If REJECTION_COUNT >= MAX_REJECTIONS: lead architectural review; lead decision; record in br comment; allow one more cycle; if still failing: PAUSE for user decision

### Step 13: Utility: State Machine Transition Validator

Inline utility. Validates and executes atomic status transitions. AC: FR-SM-1, FR-SM-4, FR-SM-8

**Actions:**
1. Valid transitions: open->in_progress; in_progress->in_review; in_review->in_qa (approved) | in_progress (rejected); in_qa->closed (passed) | in_progress (rejected)
2. Algorithm: call get_sub_state(bead_id); look up VALID_TRANSITIONS[current_state]; if target_state not allowed -> HALT; if valid -> execute: br comment add <bead_id> 'status:{target_state} {metadata}'; br sync --flush-only; if target_state=='closed' -> br close <bead_id>; if rejecting -> br update <bead_id> --status=open

### Step 14: Utility: TRD Progress Snapshot (trd_progress)

TRD-scoped progress reporting. Computes task counts scoped to current TRD only. Does NOT use bv --robot-triage (those are global). AC: FR-GD-2

**Actions:**
1. Function: trd_progress() -> prints TRD-scoped progress summary; returns (TOTAL, CLOSED, IN_PROGRESS, OPEN, PCT)
2. Run: br list --all --limit 0 --title-contains '[trd:<TRD_SLUG>:task:' --json (requires --all to include closed; --limit 0 to bypass 50-row cap)
3. Compute: TOTAL = count; CLOSED = .status=='closed'; IN_PROGRESS = .status=='in_progress'; OPEN = .status=='open'
4. Print: '=== TRD PROGRESS: <TRD_SLUG> ===' with counts and percentage
5. TEAM_MODE=true: for each in_progress bead call get_sub_state and tally building/in_review/in_qa; append breakdown

## Phase 3: Quality Gate

### Step 1: Phase Completion Detection

Detect when all tasks in a phase are closed using PENDING_GATE_PHASE

**Actions:**
1. TRD_MODE gate:
2. If TRD_MODE == false: no phase story beads exist — Quality Gate is a no-op for non-TRD epics. Print 'Quality Gate: TRD_MODE=false (no phase gate).' and skip to step 2.
3. If TRD_MODE == true:
4. PENDING_GATE_PHASE is set by Execute phase step (g) when a phase completes
5. If PENDING_GATE_PHASE is set: use it as gate target; run node "$TRD_CLI" phase-status for confirmation
6. If confirmed complete: trigger quality gate for STORY_BEAD_IDs[GATE_PHASE]
7. If PENDING_GATE_PHASE not set: run phase-status to detect phase completion normally

### Step 2: Test Execution

Phase quality gate — scope adjusts for team QA. AC: FR-QA-7

**Actions:**
1. When TEAM_MODE=true AND QA_ENABLED=true (per-task QA already ran via step 3b):
2. Phase gate focuses on INTEGRATION-ONLY scope:
3. a. Delegate to @test-runner: run integration test suite only for files modified in this phase (exclude unit tests — already validated per-task by QA agent)
4. b. Cross-file consistency checks: API contracts, shared types/interfaces, module import/export contracts
5. c. Aggregate coverage: collect per-task coverage from QA verdict comments; compute aggregate; confirm meets strategy target
6. gate_passed = integration_tests_pass AND aggregate_coverage >= target
7. Exception: strategy=characterization or flexible -> gate_passed = true
8. 
9. When TEAM_MODE=false OR (TEAM_MODE=true AND QA_ENABLED=false):
10. Delegate to @test-runner: run full test suite (unit + integration) for files modified in this phase; report pass/fail, unit coverage %, integration coverage %
11. gate_passed = tests_pass AND unit_cov >= target AND int_cov >= target
12. Exception: strategy=characterization or flexible -> gate_passed = true

### Step 3: Gate Result Recording

Record quality gate outcome as br comment and close story on pass

**Actions:**
1. When TEAM_MODE=true AND QA_ENABLED=true: write 'Quality gate result: <PASS|FAIL> | integration: <X tests> | aggregate-coverage: <Y%> | scope: integration-only (team-QA)'; if TEAM_METRICS populated: append team metrics summary
2. When TEAM_MODE=false OR QA_ENABLED=false: write 'Quality gate result: <PASS|FAIL> | unit: <X%> | integration: <Y%> | strategy: <strategy>'
3. br sync --flush-only
4. If gate_passed: br close <STORY_BEAD_ID>; br sync --flush-only; git commit checkpoint
5. If gate_passed AND PR creation warranted: run pre-PR test gate; if pass create PR via git town propose
6. If NOT gate_passed AND blocking strategy (tdd/refactor/bug-fix): print gate failure details; PAUSE for user: fix/skip/abort
7. After all gate handling: clear PENDING_GATE and PENDING_GATE_PHASE

### Step 4: Team Performance Summary (TEAM_MODE=true only)

Print and persist team performance metrics after Quality Gate. AC: FR-TM-4, FR-TM-5

**Actions:**
1. TRD-035 — Only execute when TEAM_MODE=true AND TEAM_METRICS.tasks_completed > 0
2. Compute: total_rejections, first_pass_rate, per-builder breakdown
3. Print team performance summary block to console
4. Persist as br comment on ROOT_EPIC_ID with BUILDERS_JSON schema (TRD-036)

## Phase 4: Completion

### Step 1: Hard Completion Guard

Block finalization if any task is still open — prevents partial epic closure

**Actions:**
1. ALL-TASKS-CLOSED CHECK: run br list --status=open --json and br list --status=in_progress --json filtered by scope
2. If either returns non-empty: at least one task is not yet closed
3. Print: 'ERROR: <N> task(s) still open/in-progress. Complete all tasks before finalization.'
4. Print: 'Next phase: <NEXT_PHASE> — branch: <CURRENT_PHASE_BRANCH> — re-run: /ensemble:trd-execute <ROOT_EPIC_ID> --trd <TRD_PATH>'
5. EXIT — do not close epic, do not sync TRD checkboxes

### Step 2: Epic Closure

Close the root epic when all children are done

**Actions:**
1. Run: br close <ROOT_EPIC_ID> --reason='Bead hierarchy execution complete'
2. Run: br sync --flush-only

### Step 3: TRD Checkbox Sync (TRD_MODE only)

Update TRD file checkboxes to reflect bead closure state

**Actions:**
1. If TRD_MODE == true: For each task in TRD Master Task List: if TRD_TO_BEAD_MAP[task.id] exists and bead status == 'closed' -> replace '- [ ] **<task.id>**' with '- [x] **<task.id>**'; git commit -m 'docs(TRD): sync checkboxes to bead closure state'
2. If TRD_MODE == false: skip TRD checkbox sync

### Step 4: Completion Report

**Actions:**
1. Print completion report: GOAL, task counts, strategy, coverage summary
2. TRD_MODE gate:
3. If TRD_MODE == true:
4. Build Requirement Satisfaction Table from ROOT_EPIC_ID comments (scan for req-verified: tokens)
5. Parse each comment: req-verified:REQ-NNN, by:TRD-NNN-TEST, qa:<agent>, ac-proven:AC-NNN-M; set verification_mode
6. Print table: REQ-001: SATISFIED(qa-verified) (TRD-001-TEST) — ACs: AC-001-1, AC-001-2; etc.
7. Print TOTAL: <N> satisfied / <M> total requirements
8. Call trd_progress() for final TRD-scoped progress summary (expect 100% complete)
9. If TRD_MODE == false: skip req satisfaction and trd_progress
10. If PR creation warranted: create single PR via git town propose
11. Print stacked PR summary if STACKED_PRS=true
12. Remind user: after all PRs merge, run: mv <trd_file> docs/TRD/completed/ (TRD_MODE) or archive the epic
13. Remind user: br sync --flush-only && git add .beads/ && git commit -m 'chore: final beads sync'
